mapper.sql: (COALESCE(t.tags, '') LIKE '%地址%' OR (COALESCE(t.tags, '') NOT LIKE '%综合视频%' AND COALESCE(t.tags, '') LIKE '%附近%'))

CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.tags, '') LIKE '%地址%' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(t.douyin_id), '') WHEN COALESCE(t.tags, '') NOT LIKE '%综合视频%' AND COALESCE(t.tags, '') LIKE '%附近%' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(t.address), '') ELSE NULL END

COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS waiting, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS running, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IS NULL OR t.status NOT IN ('0', '1', '2', '3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `unknown`
mapper.select: SELECT , COUNT(DISTINCT t.task_id) AS taskTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.dev_id), '')) AS activeDevices, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.run_num IS NULL OR t.run_num < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(SUM(t.run_num), 0) END AS runTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.run_num >= 0 THEN t.run_num ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runKnownTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.run_num IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runMissing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.run_num < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runInvalid FROM video_tags t
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_tags t WHERE t.update_time IS NULL AND t.create_time IS NULL

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.update_time, t.create_time), '%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.update_time, t.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error FROM video_tags t AND COALESCE(t.update_time, t.create_time) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
SELECT AS name, CONCAT('target:', ) AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS value FROM video_tags t AND AND () IS NOT NULL GROUP BY name, `key` ORDER BY value DESC, name LIMIT 12

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN AND () IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.tags, '') NOT LIKE '%地址%' AND COALESCE(t.tags, '') LIKE '%综合视频%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS searchExcluded FROM video_tags t
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.tags), ''), '未配置策略') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM video_tags t GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC, name LIMIT 12

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.dev_id), ''), '未分配设备') AS name, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error FROM video_tags t GROUP BY name ORDER BY total DESC, name LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(TRIM(t.task_name)), ''), CONCAT('任务 #', t.task_id), '未关联任务') AS name, COALESCE(CONCAT('task:', t.task_id), 'task:missing') AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error FROM video_tags t GROUP BY t.task_id ORDER BY total DESC, name LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_task WHERE type = '1'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_task WHERE type = '2'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_group
SELECT CASE status WHEN '1' THEN '在线' WHEN '0' THEN '离线' ELSE '未知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC, name
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(model), ''), '未知型号') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM device GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC, name LIMIT 12
mapper.sql: SELECT g.id, g.group_name, g.device_count AS recordedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS currentMemberCount FROM device_group g LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', REPLACE(JSON_QUOTE(COALESCE(g.dev_id, '')), ',', '","'), ']'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (token VARCHAR(2550) PATH '$')) members ON TRUE LEFT JOIN device d ON d.id = CASE WHEN TRIM(members.token) REGEXP '_[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(members.token), '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED) ELSE NULL END GROUP BY g.id, g.group_name, g.device_count
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('group:', g.id) AS `key`, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), CONCAT('分组 #', g.id)) AS name, g.currentMemberCount AS value, g.currentMemberCount, g.recordedCount FROM () g ORDER BY value DESC, g.id LIMIT 12

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(g.currentMemberCount), 0) AS membershipsTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.recordedCount IS NOT NULL AND g.recordedCount != g.currentMemberCount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mismatchedGroups, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.recordedCount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unknownRecordedGroups FROM () g

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS active, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.status IS NULL OR u.status NOT IN ('0', '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `unknown` FROM sys_user u WHERE u.del_flag = '0'

mapper.sql: SELECT v.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(v.uid), '') IS NULL THEN CONCAT('missing:', v.id) ELSE CONCAT('uid:', TRIM(v.uid)) END ORDER BY v.create_time DESC, v.id DESC) AS latest, MIN(v.create_time) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(v.uid), '') IS NULL THEN CONCAT('missing:', v.id) ELSE CONCAT('uid:', TRIM(v.uid)) END) AS first_time FROM video v

SELECT v.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(v.uid), '') IS NULL THEN CONCAT('missing:', v.source_row_number) ELSE CONCAT('uid:', TRIM(v.uid)) END ORDER BY v.create_time DESC, v.video_index DESC, COALESCE(v.video_path, '') DESC, COALESCE(v.image_path, '') DESC, COALESCE(v.json_path, '') DESC, COALESCE(v.douyin_id, '') DESC, COALESCE(v.address, '') DESC) AS latest, MIN(v.create_time) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(v.uid), '') IS NULL THEN CONCAT('missing:', v.source_row_number) ELSE CONCAT('uid:', TRIM(v.uid)) END) AS first_time FROM (SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.uid, a.create_time, a.video_index) AS source_row_number FROM address_video a) v

COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(v.video_path), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS videoFiles, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(v.image_path), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS imageFiles, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(v.json_path), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS commentFiles
